title: PG Mall 8th Anniversary - Referral Bonus
summary: Invite your friends and earn bonuses
content:
▍ Reward Program

  • Invite a friend to join as VIP 1 → 600 ETB
  • Invite a friend to join as VIP 2 → 1,870 ETB

▍ Rules

  • The invited person must register through the staff member's referral link to be counted as a valid referral.
  • You can get your referral link through the Telegram Bot, or contact the recruitment manager to learn how to obtain it.

title: Level Upgrade Subsidy Activity
summary: Upgrade to VIP level and receive additional subsidy
content:
▍ Rules

  • When users upgrade from Junior Staff to VIP 1 or higher, the company provides an additional subsidy.
  • After the level upgrade, the previous level's deposit will be fully refunded to the user.
  • On the upgrade day, you can immediately start the new level's tasks and order work.

▍ Rewards

  • Upgrade to VIP 1 or higher → Additional subsidy 600 ETB

title: Team Fixed Salary & Tax Subsidy
summary: Earn a fixed salary based on the number of VIP members in your team
content:
▍ Rules

  • A fixed salary is paid once per month on the 1st (UTC).
  • After meeting the tax subsidy criteria, you can request a subsidy fund each successful financial cycle.
  • This benefit is permanent — the more members you have, the higher your salary payment.
  • Only VIP level members (VIP 1/2/3) in your team are counted.

title: Quiz Competition
summary: Participate every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday and win
time: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday at 7:00 PM UTC+3 | 1:00 PM Habesha Time
content:
▍ Rules

  • Each event includes 10 fun Q&A questions.
  • The first three users to answer correctly can receive a 30 ETB bonus.

▍ How to Claim

After the competition ends, take a screenshot of the winners' list and send it to the recruitment manager to claim your bonus.

title: 10 ETB Raffle Entry Activity
summary: Participate with 10 ETB and win 5,000 ETB
time: When 500 spots are filled, draw at 15:00 (UTC+3) | 9:00 Habesha Time the next day
content:
▍ How to Participate

  • Every entry slot has a chance to win 5,000 ETB.
  • Each entry slot costs 10 ETB.
  • Entry fees are non-refundable.

▍ Results Announcement

The winner will be announced at 15:00 (UTC+3) | 9:00 Habesha Time the next day after all 500 spots are filled.

▍ Prize Claim Period

The winner must contact the recruitment manager within 24 hours after the announcement to claim the prize. After receiving the prize, a winner verification video is required to confirm authenticity.
